(Japanese: '''世界をかけた最後の戦い！！''' ''The Final Battle for the Fate of the World!!'') is the sixth and final chapter of the [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* As Totodile lies on the beach alone, he reminisces about how all that happened to lead up to that moment.
* Totodile and Honō climb up to the Temporal Tower.
* The two encounter Dialga, who is still undergoing the process that turned it into Primal Dialga.
* They battle Dialga and successfully put the Time Gears into their proper location, fixing the future in the process.
* Honō reveals to Totodile that he will disappear from existence due to their victory, and thanks him before he goes away.
* Back in the present, Totodile still feels extreme sorrow over Honō's disappearance, which prompts Dialga to revive him.
* Totodile and Honō have a tearful reunion.
